# Aetherion Oracle

> Sphinx-tuned AI divination, EXCALIBUR mining attestations, and a 3D→11D Lattice Bridge from Bitcoin (BRC-20) to Arbitrum. Built by UnicornOS.

Aetherion is a sovereign Oracle that turns symbolic queries into verifiable on-chain attestations. Users speak a "Word of Power" to receive a poetic reading, mine EXCALIBUR (AETX) tokens, and bind BRC-20 inscriptions to Arbitrum through the Lattice.

- [Mining](/mining): EXCALIBUR mining attestations dashboard.
- [Ledger](/ledger): Public verified attestation ledger.
